fact: The clearing is dominated by a throne of intertwined fungal growths.
source_quote: dominated by a throne of intertwined fungal growths
subject: grim clearing

fact: Twisted mushroom sentinels ring the clearing and are mottled with mold.
source_quote: ringed by twisted mushroom sentinels mottled with mold
subject: twisted mushroom sentinels

fact: Zuggtmoy is the Demon Queen of Fungi.
source_quote: This was Zuggtmoy herself, the Demon Queen of Fungi
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: A spectral figure of Zuggtmoy shimmers into view at the center of the clearing.
source_quote: Then a spectral figure shimmered into view at the center, shifting between radiant beauty and horrifying decay
subject: Zuggtmoy manifestation

fact: Zuggtmoy offers Thorin and Gyrgum the gift of becoming part of her endless mycelium forever.
source_quote: offered her gift: to bloom beyond the bounds of flesh and time and become part of her endless mycelium forever
subject: Zuggtmoy's offer

source_quote: But in the end he declined, telling the Dark Lady that he had too many responsibilities in the waking world to linger with her
subject: Thorin's refusal

fact: Thorin references Andre the Giant from The Princess Bride when greeting Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Thorin greets her "as Andre the Giant from the Princess Bride."
subject: Andre the Giant

fact: The Princess Bride is cited as the source of Andre the Giant.
source_quote: as Andre the Giant from the Princess Bride
subject: The Princess Bride

source_quote: Gyrgum's player leaves the session here
subject: Gyrgum's player leaves

fact: Thorin and Gyrgum wake up back in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
source_quote: Thorin and Gyrgum woke up back in the Whorlstone Tunnels
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Thorin feels the temptation of Zuggtmoy's offer keenly.
subject: Thorin

fact: Zuggtmoy regards Thorin with something like sorrow after his refusal.
source_quote: Zuggtmoy regarded him with something like sorrow
subject: Zuggtmoy's sorrow

fact: The vision of Zuggtmoy dissolves after Thorin's refusal.
subject: vision dissolves

fact: Companions are staring at Thorin and Gyrgum when they wake up.
source_quote: with their companions staring at them
subject: companions

fact: The DM states that if Zuggtmoy wanted to kill Thorin, she could have.
source_quote: The DM: "If she wanted to kill you, she could have killed you."
subject: DM ruling on safety

fact: The DM states that deals with demons give power at great cost.
source_quote: deals with demons always give you power at great cost
subject: DM ruling on demon deals

fact: Thorin's deciding roll to resist Zuggtmoy was really close.
subject: Thorin's roll

fact: Gyrgum wakes up alongside Thorin in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
source_quote: Thorin and Gyrgum woke up back in the Whorlstone Tunnels
subject: Gyrgum
